test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
This question has three statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

•Some J’s are A’s.

•Some A’s are B’s.

•All the B’s are C’s.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some C’s are A’s.

II. Some B’s are J’s.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows
Both Conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bf8ad845dad70886706b5735bb57a7987d1fb53b542fd0ad3a2ed449754930d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some C’s are A’s → **True** (Some A’s are B’s and all the B’s are C’s implies that some A's which are B are also C).

II. Some B’s are J’s → **False** (Some J’s are A and some A’s are B
 implies that some B’s can be J. This is possible but not definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusion I follows"**.
